items.title: Rivian (RIVN) Warns Chinese EV Costs Could Bite As Uber Robotaxi Plan Advances
items.summary: Rivian Automotive (NasdaqGS:RIVN) CEO flagged Chinese electric vehicle makers as a major competitive threat due to lower cost structures and access to government-backed capital. The CEO outlined how these non market advantages could pressure Western EV manufacturers on pricing and margins. Rivian also updated investors on its partnership with Uber, targeting deployment of autonomous robotaxis in urban areas by 2028.
